name: Balaji Telefilms Limited
about: Balaji Telefilms Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the television content business in India and internationally. The company operates through the Commissioned Programmes, Films, and Digital segments. Its Commissioned Programmes segment provides television serials to channels and digital content to OTT platforms. The Films segment is involved in the production and / or distribution of motion pictures and films. Its Digital segment offers subscription-based sale of digital content. In addition, the company provides Kutingg, a vertical short-format OTT; AstroGuide, an astrology application; Balaji Studio, an agile production platform; and Hoonur, a talent management vertical. Balaji Telefilms Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
